description:
Search Reactome pathways by name or filter by top-level category.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_pathways — one record = one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene.
Key: id, pathways[].pathwayId, pathways[].topLevelTerm.
Results: ranked by gene_count desc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.membership` counts memberships; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.pathway` counts pathways.
topLevelTerm keeps one value of reactome_pathway; records under several are missed.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Lowest-level Reactome annotations, not propagated to every ancestor; a gene missing from a pathway is unannotated there.

query.description: A case-insensitive substring search: every stored value containing the text is pooled into the results and counted in `_vbt.total`.
